resources.string:
"Start with a profile that passes the HTTPS test on your current network. The protocol name alone cannot predict speed.

Web / TCP: REALITY, XHTTP, VLESS WebSocket, SSH and NaiveProxy are candidates when UDP is restricted. Their servers still need to be reachable. SOCKS5 depends on the proxy server.

UDP: Hysteria2 and WireGuard require a working UDP path. If UDP is blocked, try a Web / TCP profile.

DNS / alternative: DNSTT, NoizDNS, VayDNS, Slipstream and Soar can provide alternative paths when normal access fails; DNS tunnels are usually a fallback for light traffic. DoH and Tor behave differently and depend on their configuration.

HTTPS test: three fresh HTTPS requests through the selected tunnel to www.gstatic.com. The displayed number includes SOCKS connection, TLS and the HTTP response; it is not ICMP ping or download speed. 3/3 means three requests succeeded in this short test, not proven long-term stability. Spread is max minus min. Results depend on the test destination and become stale when the network changes.

Test all while disconnected: profiles connect one at a time, then disconnect and sort by measured HTTPS latency. The test uses a small amount of traffic and may take about a minute per unavailable profile. Unverified TCP port checks do not count as working VPN connections."
"Quick Soar scan: checks the server’s authenticated handshake through each resolver, without generic DNS-score filtering. Select UDP, TCP or both; no saved connection policy is changed."
"Full Soar check: establishes an authenticated tunnel, then requests the test URL, which must return HTTP 204; Soar + SSH also checks the SSH account against previously approved server identities."
"Prism for Soar repeats real Ed25519-authenticated Soar handshakes. It does not use DNSTT’s HMAC challenge, DNS padding setting or generic DNS prefilter. Results identify the tested UDP/TCP paths."
"Diagnostic DNS checks only. A DNS score is not proof that a resolver carries Soar. Use Quick, E2E or Prism to verify the actual Soar server."

"No resolver completed the Soar handshake on the selected transports. Check the zone and server key, try both UDP and TCP, or increase the timeout. A result from another protocol alone does not verify this Soar server."
